title: Wild Garlic and Pilaf French Casserole
description: A hearty and flavorful casserole that combines the earthy taste of wild garlic with the nuttiness of pilaf. French cuisine at its finest.
instructions: Cook pilaf according to package instructions.
In a skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add wild garlic, garlic, salt, and pepper. Cook until wild garlic is tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked pilaf, wild garlic mixture, and shredded Gruyère cheese.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
